art_direction: 微弯半垂眼含蓄带笑，蜜珀杏黄虹膜，燕麦底与轻扬短嘴。
composition: optically centered five-feature face, two comparable eyes, two brows, a short mouth; ample negative space
creative_direction: Create a knowing little smile through the shape of the eyes rather than exaggerated facial marks. Use two softly curved, moderately narrow almond openings, with relaxed upper lids and subtly lifted lower outer corners. Both eyes remain visibly open, their broad pupils directed together just to the viewer's left. The outer tips are curved tapers, not triangles or sharp wedges. Warm amber sits beside the black pupils and blends into a small patch of apricot gold below; keep the colored areas compact so the expression remains graphic at avatar scale. Give each pupil one generous cream-colored painted highlight, softly irregular and similar in direction. The eyebrows are short, airy strokes that extend slightly toward the temples, reinforcing easy amusement. The mouth is a small shallow rising curve with only one end very slightly higher. Use muted oatmeal paper to complement the warm eyes. Aim for charming adult wit and understated warmth, without a broad grin, squinting, or a childish cartoon expression.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed contact sheet inspected for appealing coordinated eye shapes and gaze, large dark pupils and ivory highlights, centered composition, quiet pale background, restrained matte palette, no head or extra features, no text or watermark
